overview: The Medford Board of Assessors elected Chief Assessor Ted Costigan as Chair and acted on various motor vehicle, statutory, personal property, and real estate tax abatements and exemptions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Board tabled minutes from October through January and approved the minutes from February 15 and March 29, 2023.

items.title: Election of Board Chair
items.summary: Ted Costigan was nominated and elected as Chair of the Board of Assessors.

items.title: Motor Vehicle Excise Tax Abatements
items.summary: The Board approved an abatement correcting a state MSRP clerical error on a 2023 vehicle alongside a batch of 100 routine motor vehicle excise abatements.

items.title: Statutory Tax Exemptions
items.summary: The Board accepted twelve statutory exemption certificates across veteran, CPA, and other assistance categories.

items.title: Senior Tax Exemption Denials
items.summary: The Board signed denials for three low-income senior exemption applications that did not meet income or asset limits.

items.title: Real Property Abatements
items.summary: The Board reduced the assessed values for 6 Gibson Circle and 49 Bowdoin Street following data and condition corrections, while denying an abatement for 7 Morgan Avenue.

items.title: Motor Vehicle Excise Commitment
items.summary: The Board authorized a late commitment for three motor vehicle excise bills totaling $106.

items.title: Uncollectible Personal Property Taxes
items.summary: The Board reviewed and approved writing off approximately $7,609 in long-uncollectible personal property taxes.

items.title: Personal Property Abatements
items.summary: The Board denied a personal property abatement for N-Star Gas pending appeal and granted an abatement to Save More Liquors upon confirming the business is located in Somerville.

items.title: Pro Forma Tax Commitment
items.summary: The Board signed a pro forma tax bill for a medical office property that transitioned from tax-exempt to taxable status upon sale.
